# Show the remaining limit

As a Portal customer I want to see how much I can still send today so that I don't try a transfer that will be refused.

## Acceptance criteria

- Given an account with a limit of 1000 that has sent 900 today, when the portal asks for its limit, then GET /accounts/{id}/limit returns limit 1000 and remaining 100. (specs/transfer-limits/spec.md:17)
